title: Passage 1
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Once upon a time, there was a little boy.
His parents were poor farmers.
sentences.cn: 他的父母都是贫穷的农民。

sentences.en: They couldn't pay for a worker.
So the boy had to help.
He worked hard.
Every day, he had a one-hour rest at sunset.
sentences.cn: 每天日落时分，他有一个小时的休息时间。

sentences.en: He used that time
to climb to the top of a hill.
There, he could see a house
sentences.cn: 在那里，他能看到一栋房子

sentences.en: on another hill.
It had golden windows.
They were really bright and shone like diamonds.
sentences.cn: 它们非常明亮，像钻石一样闪闪发光。

sentences.en: One day, the boy's father said to him,
sentences.cn: 一天，男孩的父亲对他说：

sentences.en: You worked really hard,
so you can take a day off.
Try to learn something good.
sentences.cn: 试着去学点有用的东西吧。

sentences.en: The boy thanked his father.
Then, he left home
and walked to the far hill.
He came to the house
and knocked on the door.
Then a girl answered.
He told her about the golden windows.
sentences.cn: 他告诉她关于金色窗户的事。

sentences.en: The girl shook her head and said,
Poor farmers like us only have glass windows.
sentences.cn: 像我们这样的穷苦农民只有玻璃窗。

sentences.en: Look there!
That's the house with the golden windows.
sentences.cn: 那才是有金色窗户的房子。

sentences.en: She pointed at something far away.
sentences.cn: 她指向远方的一处地方。

sentences.en: When the boy looked,
he saw his own house.
sentences.cn: 他看到了自己家的房子。

sentences.en: He then thanked the girl
and rushed home.
Inside, he saw his family and smiled.
sentences.cn: 在家里，他看到了家人，笑了。

sentences.en: He told them about his excellent day.
sentences.cn: 他向他们讲述了自己这美好的一天。

sentences.en: He also said, "I learned a great lesson.
sentences.cn: 他还说：“我学到了很重要的一课。

sentences.en: Our house has golden windows."
